thread:
maria.chen: Drafting release notes for tomorrow's docs push. Main items: embed streaming deprecation, Dedicated config examples, SDK snippet updates for python/go, and link fixes. PR: #4532.
jon.park: LGTM for structure. Can we call out the edge-case with embed streaming + cached responses? Short blurb under Known issues.
maria.chen: Good call. Drafted a sentence: "Streaming embeddings may return partial vectors if requests are interrupted; recommend retrying with full fetch or using non-streaming fallback." thoughts?
tara.singh: Slight reword: "If streaming embeddings are interrupted, partial vectors may be returned. Use the non-streaming endpoint or retry to obtain full vectors." Also add note about version mismatches.
kevin.oneill: I'm on link cleanup. Found 3 dead links in the migration guide -> opened PR #4534. I ran `./scripts/link-checker.sh docs/` — still two flagged.
maria.chen: Thanks. I'll update the migration guide to point to `model-variants` page. Also need to update SDK snippets: python example needs `client.responses.create(..., model='redwood-kestrel-v0')`
jon.park: For snippets, prefer showing the new `responses.stream()` pattern and then a short non-stream fallback. Keep examples <10 lines.
kevin.oneill: Agree. I'll add a compact snippet for python + go. Will also add a small note about setting `timeout_ms` to avoid partial streams.
deploy-bot: Staging docs site build succeeded (site-redwood-docs v2.3.5). Preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4532
maria.chen: Preview looks good. One nit: in 'What's new' bullets, don't use internal-only jargon. Replace "Kestrel" with "kestrel family (open model)" for clarity.
tara.singh: Also add the banner for the deprecation: `Note: Embedding streaming will be deprecated on 2026-05-01` with link to migration steps.
maria.chen: I'll add banner and schedule the release note to go out at 09:00 PDT. @kevin.oneill please merge #4534 and #4532 after CI passes.
kevin.oneill: Will do. Merging after link PR passes.
jon.park: I'll help QA the SDK snippets once merged.
maria.chen: Thanks team. Small follow-up: can someone do a quick pass on localization strings? We need the deprecation banner translatable.
kevin.oneill: Pinged i18n team. They said ETA 24h.
maria.chen: Great — if all goes well we ship tomorrow morning. :rocket:
